name: seller_web_app
description: A Django-based web application for managing daily store operations. Features include real-time stock tracking, sales logging, debt management, and a Progressive Web App (PWA) integration for offline capabilities. Configured for seamless serverless deployment on Vercel.

paragraphs: A lightweight, robust Django web application built to streamline daily store operations. SellerOps provides a centralized dashboard to manage inventory stock, record sales, and track outstanding debts. Designed with Progressive Web App (PWA) support, it offers a resilient, app-like experience even on unstable networks.
features: Sales Tracking: Quickly add and log daily sales via an intuitive interface.
Stock Management: Monitor inventory levels and update product stock in real-time.
Debt Monitoring: Keep a clear ledger of outstanding customer debts and payments.
PWA Ready: Installable on mobile devices with an offline fallback page for uninterrupted workflow.
Serverless Deployment: Pre-configured with vercel.json and build scripts for seamless hosting on Vercel.
